sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.

1. Heard Sri Noor Ahmad (Aor No.A/N0437/19)), holding brief of Sri Mohd. Naushad learned
counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The applicant herein has filed the present application u/s 528 Bnss to quash/set aside the
summoning order dated 10.08.2015 passed by the Civil Judge (S.D.)/A.C.J.M. Kairana, Shamli in
Complaint Case No. 1418 of 2022, under Section 376 Ipc titled Smt. Hamida vs. Sattar and another.

3.  Sri Noor Ahmad (AOR No.A/N0437/19), holding brief of Sri Mohd. Naushad, learned counsel for the applicants on instructions seeks to withdraw the present application with liberty to file fresh on account of technical inherent defects.
However, he submits that the certified copy be returned subject to furnishing of the photocopy.
4. Learned AGA has no objection to the same.
